title: Shapes and a parser with errors
hints: func (r Rect) Area() float64 { return r.W * r.H } and func (r Rect) Name() string { return "rect" }. The same two for Circle.
Largest: return nil, ErrNoShapes for an empty slice. Otherwise keep the best one while looping.
ParseShape: parts := strings.Fields(text), convert parts[1:] with strconv.ParseFloat(part, 64), and return fmt.Errorf("%w: %q", ErrBadShape, text) for anything unexpected.
